scope: real PS Vita hardware run of private full-engine build 00.07
result: engine initialized and ran 498 frames, then exited cleanly after the original Run() caught a NullPointerException in Game9 state 61
additional_observation: DrawExec also raised repeated caught NullPointerExceptions from the first rendered frames, indicating a renderer/text lifecycle resource was never initialized rather than a Game9-only data failure.

root_cause.details: GlobalWork.bResume defaults to false. The original TCBManajer.Run() allocates StringTexture[0] and StringTexture[1], resets Graphics2D and restores BGM only on the bResume == true edge, then clears bResume itself. VitaEngine never generated the initial Android-style resume edge, so DrawExec and later DrawText accessed text surfaces that had never been initialized.
root_cause.why_it_matches_the_trace: The missing resume edge explains both the repeated DrawExec NPEs from the first frame and the final DrawText NPE in Game9(61), without requiring any modification to Game9 or GDT data.

fix.strategy: Set gw.bResume=true once after successful original engine Init and before the first Run(), allowing the original lifecycle branch to perform its own StringTexture/Graphics2D/BGM initialization and clear the flag.

next_private_test_artifact.name: DBTapBattle-Vita-00.08-resumefix.vpk
next_private_test_artifact.expected_next_checkpoint: no repeated DrawExec text-surface NPEs; Game9 state 61 should be able to create/draw text and advance beyond the previous 498-frame clean exit
